_doc: Ledger of cartoon shorts (the daily automatic method). The producer appends one entry with status 'produced'; the publish job turns it into 'published'. Never repeat or closely paraphrase a topic listed here.

episodes.title: What If You Jumped Into a Hole Through the Earth?
episodes.topic: falling through a tunnel through the centre of the Earth (gravity tunnel, 38 minutes one way, oscillates forever)

episodes.title: What If You Had a Hummingbird's Metabolism? 🤔
episodes.topic: a man with a hummingbird's energy use per gram: 120,000 calories a day, a burger every three minutes, and too little skin to lose 6 kW of heat (square-cube law); the bird's own answer is nightly torpor
episodes.trend: youtube_shorts: the week's top 'what if' row is 'What If Humans Had Hummingbird Hearts' (3.95M views/day) plus an Arabic remake; body and everyday scenarios beat space topics

episodes.title: What If You Tried to Open a Plane Door Mid-Flight? ✈️
episodes.topic: trying to open an airliner's exit door at cruise: cabin pressure holds the plug door shut with almost 20,000 pounds (8 psi on 2,448 square inches, four cars); suction-cup analogy; it only lets go on the ground
episodes.trend: youtube_shorts: 'What if a Plane Door Opened Mid-flight' (2.11M views/day) is the strongest undone 'what if' row; everyday travel scenarios win for several channels this week
